name: architect
description: Spec-to-build pipeline for backend features: design a feature as a folder of small role-tagged blocks with endpoint and schema specs kept once in shared files; slice it into wave-ordered task briefs (contracts first); build tasks in parallel with an isolated branch and PR per task or per wave behind test and review gates; run several epics side by side; fix spec-rooted bugs code-then-docs behind two approval gates; and keep the design in step with changing requirements and drifting code.
